name: Lurker In Light

spells.name: Translocate (Only when in bright light, and only to an area in bright light)
spells.text:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

---

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

spells.name: Blindness
spells.text:
You blind the target. The effect is determined by the target's Fortitude save. The target then becomes temporarily immune for 1 minute.

---

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Blinded until its next turn begins.

Failure The target is Blinded for 1 minute.

Critical Failure The target is Blinded permanently.

spells.name: Holy Light
spells.text:
You shine a blazing ray of light tinged with holy energy. Make a ranged spell attack. The ray deals 5d6 fire damage. If the target has the unholy trait, you deal an extra 5d6 spirit damage.

---
Critical Success The target takes double damage.

Success The target takes full damage.

If the light passes through an area of magical darkness or targets a creature affected by magical darkness, holy light attempts to counteract the darkness. If you need to determine whether the light passes through an area of darkness, draw a line between yourself and the spell's target.

---
Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 2d6, and the spirit damage against unholy creatures increases by 2d6.

spells.name: Figment
spells.text:
You create a simple illusory sound or vision. A sound adds the auditory trait to the spell and the sound can't include intelligible words or elaborate music. A vision adds the visual trait, can be no larger than a 5-foot cube, and is clearly crude and undetailed if viewed from within 15 feet. When you Cast or Sustain the Spell, you can attempt to Create a Diversion with the illusion, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your Deception check. If the attempt fails against a creature, that creature disbelieves the figment.

Spell Effect: Figment

spells.name: Light
spells.text:
You create an orb of light that sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet) in a color you choose. If you create the light in the same space as a willing creature, you can attach the light to the creature, causing it to float near that creature as it moves. You can Sustain the spell to move the light up to 60 feet; you can attach or detach it from a creature as part of this movement.

You can Dismiss the spell. If you Cast the Spell while you already have four light spells active, you must choose one of the existing spells to end.

Spell Effect: Light

---

Heightened (4th) The orb sheds light in a 60-foot radius (and dim light for the next 60 feet).

spells.name: Summon Fey
spells.text:
You summon a creature that has the fey trait and whose level is –1 to fight for you.

---

Heightened As listed in the summon trait.

spells.name: Summon Fey
spells.text:
You summon a creature that has the fey trait and whose level is –1 to fight for you.

---

Heightened As listed in the summon trait.

spells.name: Telekinetic Hand
spells.text:
You create a floating, magical hand, either invisible or ghostlike, that grasps the target object and levitates it slowly up to 20 feet in any direction. When you Sustain the spell, you can move the object an additional 20 feet. If the object is in the air when the spell ends, the object falls.

---

Heightened (3rd) You can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 1 or less.

Heightened (7th) The range increases to 60 feet, and you can target an unattended object with a Bulk of 2 or less.

items.name: Blend with Light
items.text:
Trigger The lurker in light uses a move action

Requirements The lurker in light is in an area of bright light

---
Effect The lurker in light becomes invisible until they enter an area of dim light or darkness, or until they use a hostile action.

items.name: Lurker's Glow
items.text:
A creature that takes damage from a lurker in light's mote of light Strike must attempt a DC 22 Will save save.

Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to lurker's glow for 24 hours.

Failure The creature is lined in golden light for 1 minute and can't be Concealed during this time. If the creature becomes invisible, it's concealed rather than undetected.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature sheds bright light in a 20-foot emanation for the duration of the effect. In addition, the creature is Dazzled until the end of its next turn.

items.name: Ritual Gate
items.text:
Requirements The lurker in light has reduced a living creature to 0 Hit Points on this turn or their previous turn and has a Summon Fey innate spell available

---
Effect The lurker in light casts summon fey with only a concentrate trait, using the act of slaughter to replace the normal manipulate traits for the spell. If the fey creature summoned shares the lurker in light's current goals, the lurker in light can sustain the summon fey spell for up to 1 hour instead of 1 minute.

items.name: Sneak Attack
items.text: A lurker in light's Strikes deal an additional 2d6 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

text:
As easily as a Darklands predator hides in the unsettling mystery of shadows, a lurker in light disappears into the brightest light. These malicious and strange fey appear as fairies about 2 feet tall, with insectile wings, large eyes, and bulbous heads. They slaughter and cause mischief in patterns only their alien intellect understands, but they've been seen to take particular umbrage with dwarves, gnomes, and creatures who live in darkness. With their relentless grudges and pursuit of their own wicked and sadistic whims, lurkers in light deftly overturn the conventional wisdom that creatures associated with light are benign and friendly.

Though lurkers in light are fey and have ties to the First World, these creatures are often found elsewhere in the Great Beyond. They're particularly fond of invading the Netherworld to bring light to those who dwell there—not to help, but to spread misery and pain among those to whom light is agonizing.
